**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Meetings
- **Fewer phantom lines in transcripts.** Near-silent stretches sometimes came back as a single Glossary word or the whole Glossary behind a speaker label ("Speaker A: …"). Those lines are now dropped as well.

## Sidebar
- **Simpler date groups.** Chats and meetings are grouped into Today, Yesterday, Previous 30 Days and Older. The separate "Previous 7 Days" group is gone.
- **One line per title.** Long chat and meeting titles no longer wrap to two lines. Hover to see the full title.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.65...v8.66
